name: pathless forest
source:
A curse has chosen a new victim as you help Joona navigate their way through the never-ending forest.

Every curse is different, and every choice has a consequence. Joona will learn from your actions.

But it was never about the curse, was it? Or about Joona.

[From [url=https://quilzs.itch.io/pathless-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诅咒选中了新的受害者，而你将帮助Joona在无尽的森林中寻找道路。

每个诅咒都不一样，每个选择都有后果。Joona会从你的行动中学习。

但这一切从来都不是为了诅咒，对吧？也不是为了Joona。

[摘自[url=https://quilzs.itch.io/pathless-forest]itch.io[/url]]
